name: Meetup Groups - Sports
description: Soccer, running, pickleball, tennis, golf, fencing and beach volleyball groups around San Diego County, found through Meetup's sports searches.

groups.name: Encinitas Pickleball
groups.description: Pickleball for all levels, built on encouragement and kindness. New players are asked to spend 10 minutes learning the basics first.
groups.address: Cottonwood Creek Park, 95 N Vulcan Ave, Encinitas (under the Court #1 sign, west side)

groups.name: Sports Meetup, All Welcome
groups.description: Emmanuel Faith Community Church's outreach group for adults and families to stay active through soccer, basketball, fencing and hiking. All skill levels welcome.
groups.address: Emmanuel Faith Community Church, 639 E 17th Ave, Escondido

groups.name: San Diego Social Golf
groups.description: A coed social golf group for all skill levels since 2006, with weekday and weekend rounds, tournaments and discounted green fees. Has an optional Low Net league.
groups.frequency: Several rounds a month, weekdays and weekends

cost.note: $85 a year, plus each course's green fees

groups.name: SD Tennis
groups.description: Daily pickup tennis for every level, split into Beginners (2.0-), Intermediate (2.5+) and Advanced (4.0+) games.
groups.address: Public courts in Carlsbad and Oceanside

cost.note: $30 a year after a 14-day free trial

groups.name: Oceanside Dink & Rally
groups.description: Weekly social pickleball for beginners through intermediate players in North County.
groups.address: Melba Bishop Recreation Center, 5306 North River Rd, Oceanside

cost.note: first visit free; then a $5 donation every other month

groups.name: VBOS Beach Volleyball
groups.description: Volleyball Oceanside runs beach volleyball leagues, clinics, tournaments and social events for beginners and experienced players.
groups.address: Warm Water beach volleyball courts, south of Lifeguard Tower 32, 4355 Carlsbad Blvd, Carlsbad

cost.note: $24.99 drop-in

groups.name: Balboa Park Saturday Morning Soccer
groups.description: Pickup 8-on-8 soccer at Balboa Park with three rotating teams. Spots are capped per game, so RSVP on Meetup.
groups.address: War Memorial Building, Park Blvd, Balboa Park

cost.note: $10 one-time donation the first time you play

groups.name: SD Fun Run
groups.description: A social running group for people in their 20s and 30s. Each Wednesday they run about 4 miles from a different bar and finish there for drinks. All paces welcome.

groups.name: Casual Coed Soccer
groups.description: Casual, coed, non-competitive soccer for adults 18+, mostly intermediate and advanced players but all levels welcome. No referees; players call their own fouls.
groups.address: Liberty Station and Snapdragon Stadium's River Park
groups.frequency: Tuesdays and Thursdays 5:00 PM at Liberty Station; Thursdays 4:30 PM and Sundays 8:00 AM beginner-friendly at Snapdragon

cost.note: donations welcome

groups.name: San Diego Volleyball for a Cause
groups.description: Weekly beach volleyball for intermediate players and up, raising money for local and global causes. Teams are matched by skill.

cost.note: optional donations; half go to the week's charity

groups.name: Soccer at Snap
groups.description: Intermediate and advanced pickup soccer several days a week, on big fields with full-size goals in the parks next to Snapdragon Stadium.
groups.address: Parks around Snapdragon Stadium and SDSU
groups.frequency: Tuesdays, Thursdays 4:30 PM; Wednesdays 3:30 PM at SDSU; Saturdays 8:00 AM

groups.name: Coronado Soccer
groups.description: Weekly coed soccer for all skill levels, with goals, pinnies and cones provided. No hard tackles or sliding. RSVP on Meetup to play.

cost.note: $5 a game, or $20 for six months, the first time

groups.name: Social Soccer on Mission Bay
groups.description: Pickup soccer every Saturday at Ski Beach on Mission Bay.
groups.address: Ski Beach, 1600 Vacation Rd, San Diego

cost.note: $5 Venmo donation suggested the first time
